visualReview.notes: Detached southern polygonal latrine remains, on its own exact eight-sided mapped footprint east of the southern apartments. Main villa, Triclinium, Xystus, entrance and the northern east-latrine draft remain independent. West gap, thickness, heights and unseen faces are approximate exterior interpretations. This member completes only the southern polygonal latrine; east-latrine draft remains unresolved.
